name: Quick ticket
description:
**Conversation summary**

1. **Quick ticket entry** — the solopreneur home `+` was repurposed from "new project" to capture a quick ticket, reusing `SprintBoardModals` (board type `sprint`) hosted in `SolopreneurView`, with creation routed through `storex.kanban.newSprintTask` plus message/files/cost persistence.
2. **Compact mode** — `SprintBoardModals` gained a `compact` prop (`!state.viewport.isWide`) that trims optional fields, keeps the project picker (iconified), drops the chat-mode selector in favour of `chat`, and adds an **Urgent** (due tomorrow) toggle plus a `chip` cost-budget dropdown.
3. **Modal header fix** — `Modal.vue` now renders its header only when a `title` prop or `#header` slot exists (new `title` prop), recovering the wasted ~40px; the New Task title (with urgent badge) moved there.
4. **Mobile fullscreen** — a new opt-in `fullscreen` prop on `Modal` makes the ticket dialog take the viewport (`:fullscreen="compact"`), with `100dvh` and safe body padding; all other dialogs stay unchanged.
5. **Card identity kept** — fullscreen was refined to keep radius/border/shadow with a `px-2 py-1` inset frame and `overflow-hidden` clipping, dropping only the zoom-in animation.

In solopreneur home the "plus" must allow to create a quick ticket.
Us the  sprint modals but sompact for mobile

I'll explore the solopreneur home area to understand the current "plus" behavior.## 1. Review & understanding - Solopreneur **home** has a single primary action in the top bar: the `+` button, which currently opens **“Add new project”**. - Requirement: that `+` must create a **quick ticket** (a sprint task), without leaving the dashboard. - Constraint: reuse **`SprintBoardModals.vue`** (the dialog the sprint board uses) but make it **compact on narrow screens (mobile)**. ## 2. What I found | Item | Detail | |---|---| | Entry point | `SolopreneurTopbar.vue` → primary `+` (`openModal('newProject')`) | | Host | `views/SolopreneurView.vue` (renders topbar + module + `SolopreneurModal`) | | Sprint data | `useSolopreneurProjects()` → `selectedSprint`, `sprintColumns` (`$storex.kanban.sprintColumns`), `ensureReady()` | | Creation pipeline | mirrors `SprintBoardView.onTaskCreated` → `$storex.kanban.newSprintTask` + `updateChatInfo` + `addMessage` + optional `chatWihProject` | | Width tier | `state.viewport.isWide` (measured width — correct signal on mobile **and** inside dockview panels) | ## 3. Change summary | File | Change | |---|---| | `SprintBoardModals.vue` | New `compact` prop. In the **New Task** dialog only: reduced spacing/smaller name input, hides project picker, assignees/deadline, cost budget, existing subtasks and context note; full-width action buttons. Default (`false`) behaviour is byte-for-byte identical. | | `SolopreneurTopbar.vue` | `+` becomes **Quick ticket** (`@emit('new-ticket')`, label on `md+`). New project becomes a secondary ghost/outline button. | | `SolopreneurView.vue` | Hosts `` (board type `sprint`, `:compact="!state.viewport.isWide"`), wires `@new-ticket` → opens it, and `@task-created` → creates the ticket in the open sprint. | ## 4. Changes ## 5. Verification checklist - [ ] Wide screen (≥1024px measured width): `+` opens the full dialog (project picker, assignees, deadline, cost) — unchanged from the sprint board. - [ ] Narrow/mobile: same dialog, compact — name, mode, message, Add/Run only; buttons full width; nothing overflows `90vh`. - [ ] Ticket lands in the sprint’s **first column**; `@file`/attachments become the first user message; “Run” starts the agent. - [ ] No sprint in the project → error toast + jump to **Sprints** (a ticket needs a sprint: `newSprintTask` refuses `sprintId: null`). - [ ] Keyboard: name input autofocuses, `Enter` adds, `Ctrl/Cmd+Enter` runs, `Esc` closes (Modal). - [ ] Touch targets: toolbar buttons `h-9` (36px) on mobile — matches the existing top bar; bump to `h-11` if you want strict 44px.
